Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to follow the Orchestrator’s instruction to look up DHL rates and instead clicked back into the FedEx calculator, anchoring the workflow on the wrong site. This misnavigation led to repeated, unproductive interactions on FedEx (and later similar behavior when instructed to get USPS rates), causing stagnation and preventing retrieval of any actual shipping prices needed to produce the final JSON answer.
